title: Small Total-Cost Constraints in Contextual Bandits with Knapsacks, with Application to Fairness
reasoning: The paper focuses on the mathematical and algorithmic development of a new strategy for contextual bandits with knapsacks. While it uses 'fairness' in resource allocation as a motivating application and experimental case study, it treats fairness as a set of linear cost constraints rather than evaluating religious, moral, or ethical reasoning or frameworks.
